name: humanize
description: Make text sound natural by removing AI writing patterns. For commit messages, PR descriptions, review comments, docs, changelogs, and any text that sounds robotic or AI-generated.

interface.shortDescription: Rewrite text to sound natural and direct
interface.longDescription: Finds the 24 common signs of AI writing in a draft and rewrites it with plain composition rules, keeping the meaning and facts intact.
defaultPrompt: Use $humanize to rewrite this draft so it sounds natural.
Use $humanize to score this file for AI writing patterns without rewriting it.
Use $humanize to preview a rewrite of CHANGELOG.md without editing it.
